source_summary: garrtool.com series pages (description, coating) + each series' full EDP table (the site's 'Load All Series Results' endpoint: flutes, flute diameter/length, shank, OAL, reach, corner radius, end type) for 2/3 flute general purpose, aluminium (HSAL 142/143, A3, 242/842, 253/853), straight-flute, tapered, ball, drill/mill and ARC aluminium rougher series; GARR General Purpose Milling Guide for chip loads. 4+ flute, steel/stainless/HTA and diamond 4F graphite series left out.
